crossRefs.note: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this…
For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole…

translations.web: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
translations.bsb: He who guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from distress.
translations.kjv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
translations.asv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue Keepeth his soul from troubles.
